title: Control Path Workspace Schema
description: Monorepo scaffold manifest (control-path.workspace.yaml). Created by controlpath init at repo root. Supplies namespace fallback at runtime and boilerplate for new service catalogs. Not used in multi-repo setups.

namespace.description: Domain boundary prefix for service catalogs that omit catalog.namespace (e.g. namespace 'acme' + id 'checkout-service' → 'acme.checkout-service'). Resolved by walk-up from the service control-path.yaml.

scaffold.description: Boilerplate copied into new service control-path.yaml by controlpath init. Not merged at compile or sync time.

imports.description: Default imports pre-filled when scaffolding a new service catalog.

path.description: Path to imported catalog, relative to the new service directory.

defaults.description: Default flag metadata pre-filled on scaffolded flags (e.g. owner, tags).

mode.description: Default mode pre-filled on scaffolded service catalogs.

saas.description: Default SaaS project template for scaffolded service catalogs.

workspaceSaas.description: Org-wide SaaS endpoints discovered by walk-up from service catalogs. Service file saas.api_url / saas.cdn_url take precedence when set.

api_url.description: Control Path API base URL for catalog sync (not SDK runtime polls).

cdn_url.description: CDN origin for SDK runtime polls (compiled artifacts and kill switch files).
